title: unified-rollouts-observability-autorollback-enhancements
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Automated rollback workflows (canary / A-B / shadow) have worked well at the control-plane level, but SREs lacked visibility into why rollbacks were triggered and which telemetry contributed to a decision. This PR adds richer observability plumbing (trace context, metric tagging, and per-rollout event timelines) and tightens autorollback decision logs so on-call can troubleshoot without reproducing traffic. Motivation: reduce mean-time-to-diagnose (MTTD) for rollback incidents, enable postmortem signal attribution, and unblock product teams from over-alerting by surfacing the primary metric contributors. Changes: - add rollout_event timeline emitted to trace/span for every state transition (create, scale, probe, pass/fail criteria, rollback decision) - attach model_variant and route metadata to all rollout metrics and traces - instrument composite-metric evaluator with breakdown of contributing signals (latency, error-rate, quality-regression) - persist last-5 probe snapshots as a compressed payload to the rollout record (for e2e triage) - surface rollback root-cause in the console (primary metric + delta) - add e2e tests covering observability annotations and trace continuity Checklist: - [x] data model changes (rollout_events) - [x] runtime instrumentation - [x] console UI surface - [x] tests (unit + integration) - [x] docs updates (internal runbooks) Rollout plan: feature-flagged; gradual rollout to production with 5% then 50% traffic gating. Backwards compatibility: reads default to empty timeline if not present. Operational notes: increased storage for rollout records expected ~3% (configurable retention), compressed snapshots are capped at 256KB. Related: ENG-4982 (observability for rollouts), SUP-9142 (customer incident from Jan).
commits: add: emit rollout_event timeline on state transitions
feat: tag rollout metrics with model_variant/route metadata
perf: compress and persist probe snapshots (lz4)

docs: rollout observability runbook and examples
